pluss::subsp::stats::ts::MvGarchOptions¶

Options of ts::MvGarch::fit_mle.

MvGarchOptions holds the options of the univariate model fitted to every series, and the settings of the correlation estimate.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

marginal

ts::GarchOptions

defaults

Options of the GARCH fitted to each column; see GarchOptions.

corr_shrinkage

double

1e-6

Weight in [0, 1] of the identity matrix mixed into the estimated correlation (shrinks it towards no correlation).

corr_jitter

double

1e-9

Added to the diagonal until the correlation matrix is positive definite.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
